_comment: Portable GitHub ruleset TEMPLATE for the default branch of a repository
generated from App-Factory. It is a request payload, not an export: it
contains no ruleset id, node id, repository id, timestamps, or
integration ids, so it can be applied unchanged to any new repository.
Apply it manually — see docs/FACTORY.md. Scripts in this repository
validate its shape and never call the GitHub admin API themselves.
The required status check contexts below must match the job names in
name: main-protection
